roles.title: Senior Analytical Lead, then Analytical Director

requirements.text: 8+ years of total professional experience, including 5+ years of people management
A track record of leading teams and developing talent, with the executive presence to influence senior stakeholders.
Strong data and analytics fundamentals, with the judgment to know which analysis matters and the storytelling skill to make it land.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to present complex business cases in a clear, accessible way.
Exposure to a sales or commercial environment, and a consultative approach to working with partners.
Fluency with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides; hands-on comfort with SQL and/or Python is a plus.
A background in consulting, financial services, analytics, and/or a high-growth startup environment.
Comfort with ambiguity, a bias toward driving work independently, and a quick-learner mindset.
Genuine enthusiasm for becoming an expert on financial services, fraud, and identity.
A bachelor's degree (any field); an MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must live in the United States.
As the Head of Solutions Analytics, you'll lead a team of business analysts and data scientists who are deeply embedded in SentiLink's sales process and our partner relationship…
You're a hands-on leader who pairs analytical judgment with exceptional communication skills, and who builds trusted relationships as a coach, mentor, and strategic partner, bot…
Partner with account executives on discovery, and meet with partners to shape fraud and identity strategies that mitigate risk.
Translate analysis into compelling, executive-ready narratives and presentations aligned to the value of the proposed solution.
Act as the analytical and technical thought partner to the sales team, ensuring alignment with each partner's needs.
Build, coach, and scale the Solutions Analytics team, establishing best practices and raising the bar across the group.
Expand the team's scope beyond pre-sales retros into pipeline analytics and deeper, ongoing partner consulting.
Design and execute analysis for white papers and other industry materials — surfacing relevant insights, such as emerging fraud tactics, and collaborating on publishing.
Develop and maintain durable, trusted relationships with partners over the full lifecycle.
